name: interview-me
title_zh: 用一问一答逼出你真正想要的东西
tagline_zh: 当你说“做个X”却说不清给谁用、为什么现在做——它不猜，不跳步，一次一个问题，直到95%确信你的真实意图。
tagline_en: When you say 'build me X' but can't say for whom or why now—it doesn't guess. One question at a time until 95%.
desc_en: Extracts what the user actually wants instead of what they think they should want. Achieves this through one-question-at-a-time interview until ~95% confidence about the underlying intent. Use when an ask is underspecified ("build me X" without "for whom" or "why now"), when the user explicitly invokes ("interview me", "grill me", "are we sure?", "stress-test my thinking"), or when you catch yours
why_zh: 机制是反直觉的：不总结、不假设，用单线追问逼你暴露没说出口的约束。比任何提示词模板都更接近你的真实意图。
why_en: It's anti-intuitive: no summarizing, no assuming—just relentless single-question probing that forces hidden constraints to.
limit_zh: 只处理需求模糊的对话场景，不产出代码或方案；若你已明确目标或时间紧迫，它会拖慢节奏；需要你耐心回答至少5轮问题。
limit_en: Only for underspecified asks in conversation; no code or solution output. If your goal is clear or time is short, it slows you down. Requires ≥5.
